skill_name: Describe the benefits that artificial intelligence brings to the healthcare industry.
workflow: The healthcare industry has seen tremendous benefits from the advent of artificial intelligence. AI can help doctors make more accurate diagnoses and recommend personalized treatments for conditions. It can also be used to monitor and analyze important medical data, such as drug interactions and patient outcomes, to make sure that treatments are safe and effective.
